ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 45% high-intensity pixels (white) located in lateral distal regions and 55% low-intensity pixels (black/dark gray) concentrated in the central and medial trailing edge regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white regions occupy the outer thirds of both fluke lobes. The left lobe exhibits a large white sector from the tip extending toward the center with internal dark mottling. The right lobe shows a similar white patch at the tip with a distinct dark encroachment along the medial border. Central fluke and trailing edges are dominated by solid black pigmentation.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations visible along the exposed portions of the trailing edge on both lobes. Amplitude of variations is approximately 3-5 pixels relative to the local edge baseline, interspersed with deeper, jagged indentations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex leading edge curvature tapering to acute, slightly recurved tips (points) on both lateral extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple dark, circular punctate clusters (0.5-2% of lobe area) distributed within the white pigmentation zones, particularly concentrated near the distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, near-parallel vertical dark linear streaks (rake marks) observed on the white surface of the left fluke lobe, spanning approximately 15% of the local lobe width.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of distinct vertical rake marks on the left lobe; minor irregular chipping and erosion of pixel continuity at the fluke tips.
